rounds.point: Our town should build a new park.

options.text: Children have nowhere safe to play.
Our town really needs a brand-new park.
The library closes at five o'clock.

rounds.point: Everyone should wear a helmet when biking.

options.text: Everyone should always wear a helmet.
It protects your head in a crash.
Red bikes look the coolest of all.

rounds.point: Kids should read for twenty minutes each day.

options.text: Kids should read a whole lot every day.
Math class is right after lunch.
Reading helps your brain grow strong.

rounds.point: Our class should grow a garden.

options.text: Plants give us fresh food to eat.
The bell rings at three o'clock.
Our class should plant a big garden.

rounds.point: Students should bring water bottles to school.

options.text: Buses are painted bright yellow.
Drinking keeps you healthy and awake.
Students should bring water bottles daily.

rounds.point: We should turn off lights to save power.

options.text: We should always turn the lights off.
Fridays are pizza days at school.
It is good for the whole planet.

rounds.point: Dogs should be walked every day.

options.text: Walking keeps a pet happy and fit.
Dogs really should be walked all the time.
Cats love to nap in the sun.

rounds.point: Children should help wash the dishes.

options.text: Spoons are smaller than forks.
It teaches you to care for your home.
Children should always help with the dishes.

page_title.en: Pearl's Opinion Page — Back It Up (Grade 2)

page_intro.en: Pearl the seal writes the opinion page, and every column makes a POINT — "Our town should build a new park." Your job: tap the card that BACKS IT UP with a real reason, not a card that just says the same thing again or talks about something else. A warm Grade 2 reading game about how reasons support an author's point, aligned to Common Core RI.2.8.
